title: vangueria agrestis
intro: Vangueria agrestis, commonly known as Wild Olive or Bushwillow, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and alleviating symptoms of various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Vangueria agrestis are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be beneficial in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
